payload.detail: scripts/lib/parse-differentials-export.ts now emits presentation scope directly (commit 4628295f5), but the committed data/differentials-snapshot.json predates it and cannot be regenerated in a cloud session: scripts/import-differentials-export.ts reads a Windows workstation path (C:/Users/joshs/AppData/Local/Temp/differentials-data.zip). Until then withPresentationScope() in src/lib/differentials.ts derives the same labels at load time, which keeps the app correct but means the file and the runtime describe the record differently. Next action: re-run npm-equivalent 'node scripts/run-tsx.mjs scripts/import-differentials-export.ts --zip=<path> --write' on the workstation, confirm the emitted scope matches the derivation, then consider retiring the derivation. The app stays correct meanwhile because withPresentationScope() derives the same labels at load time.
